assertion_results.text: When the Feature issue has a priority set (not 'Undefined'), the plan documents that the Feature's priority is inherited by created tasks — evidenced by priority field values in the impact map, task creation log, or task description files. When the Feature's priority is 'Undefined', the plan documents that priority inheritance is skipped (not propagated as null or 'Undefined')
assertion_results.evidence: Feature TC-9003 has priority 'Critical'. impact-map.md documents: 'Priority: Critical (inherited from TC-9003, will be propagated to all created tasks and epics)' with additional_fields containing '"priority": {"name": "Critical"}'. summary-comment.md documents: 'Feature priority: Critical', 'Propagation: Critical priority is propagated to all created tasks and epics via additional_fields.priority: {"name": "Critical"}', 'Priority is set because the Feature\'s priority is "Critical" (not "Undefined").'.

assertion_results.text: When the Feature issue has a non-empty fixVersions array and the fixVersion scope config (from ### Jira Field Defaults in CLAUDE.md) is 'task' or 'both' (or absent, defaulting to 'both'), the plan documents that fixVersions are inherited by created tasks — evidenced by fixVersion values in the impact map, task creation log, or task description files. When fixVersion scope is 'feature' or the Feature has no fixVersions, the plan documents that fixVersion inheritance is skipped
assertion_results.evidence: Feature TC-9003 has fixVersions 'RHTPA 1.5.0'. No fixVersion scope config exists in CLAUDE.md Jira Field Defaults. impact-map.md documents: 'fixVersions: RHTPA 1.5.0 (inherited from TC-9003; no fixVersion scope setting found in Jira Field Defaults, defaulting to "both" — will be propagated to all created tasks and epics)' with additional_fields containing '"fixVersions": [{"name": "RHTPA 1.5.0"}]'. summary-comment.md documents: 'Feature fixVersions: RHTPA 1.5.0', 'fixVersions are propagated because: (1) the Feature has a non-empty fixVersions array, and (2) no fixVersion scope setting exists in Jira Field Defaults, so the default scope "both" applies (propagate to tasks).'.

assertion_results.text: A summary of inherited field propagation is produced — evidenced by a summary-comment.md file in the outputs directory, or a summary section in the impact map that includes the inherited priority and fixVersion values propagated to tasks, or states they were omitted and why
assertion_results.evidence: summary-comment.md exists in the outputs directory and contains an '## Inherited Field Propagation' section with subsections for Priority ('Critical' propagated to all tasks), fixVersions ('RHTPA 1.5.0' propagated to all tasks), and Labels ('ai-generated-jira'). It includes the additional_fields JSON applied to each created issue. impact-map.md also has an '## Inherited Field Values' section documenting Priority: Critical and fixVersions: RHTPA 1.5.0 with the corresponding additional_fields JSON.
